summary: Amylyx Pharmaceuticals filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a firm-commitment underwritten public offering of 14,090,000 common shares at $35.50 per share, grossing about $500.2 million, versus an August 18, 2026 Nasdaq close of $35.11. Underwriters Leerink Partners, Morgan Stanley, Guggenheim Securities and LifeSci Capital received a 5.6% discount ($1.988/share), yielding roughly $472.2 million before expenses, plus a 30-day option on 2,113,500 additional shares. Delivery is expected August 21, 2026, under a March 3, 2026 shelf. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; watch dilution and pricing pressure.
